The data in rfc9180-base.json is a subset of the CFRG HPKE test vectors:
https://github.com/cfrg/draft-irtf-cfrg-hpke/blob/master/test-vectors.json

Selected fields are unchanged: mode 0; X25519/P-256 with HKDF-SHA256 and
P-521 with HKDF-SHA512; AES-128-GCM, AES-256-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305.
Each of the nine suites includes 257 sequential ciphertexts. P-384 suites
are covered separately by roundtrip and negative tests; this vector set does
not provide a P-384 KEM vector.
